title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Linha da Virada. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Linha da Virada
options.lineage: São Paulo metro wayfinding and line diagrams (1970s signage program)
options.thesis: The campaign is one red line running to election day; every activity is a station you board and share.
options.viewport: Phone: graphite sign bar with '11 dias até a eleição', a 'Próxima estação' platform board with the next activity and its two share buttons, then the vertical red line with days as stations, ending at the 25/10 terminal.
options.risk: Leans on São Paulo's metro language; it only earns its place if the line diagram does real work (countdown, you-are-here, past greyed).

raised.raise: On desktop the share bench is a persistent panel beside the line; picking a station changes its contents, never the layout.
One reserved colour, platform yellow, means 'próxima' and nothing else.
Every time sits in a fixed tabular-figure column, so a day reads like a departures board.
Nothing is labelled twice: an activity's type is said once, by its line bullet.
Two line weights only: the thick route line and one-pixel seams.

options.label: Lambe-lambe
options.lineage: Brazilian wheat-paste street posters (gráficas de lambe-lambe)
options.thesis: Every activity is a poster pasted on the city wall: fluorescent stock, stacked wood type, repetition.
options.viewport: Phone: a wall of tiled posters, one per activity, the next one pasted on top in red-on-fluoro; tap a poster to share it.
options.risk: Closest to the current look and to where most runs in this category land: heavy condensed type on flat saturated ink.

options.label: Bilhete de Ida
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets (coupon books, carbon numerals, VOID stamps)
options.thesis: Every activity is a tear-off coupon; you tear one and forward it.
options.viewport: Phone: a stacked coupon book, one stub per activity with carbon date and time; past coupons stamped REALIZADA.
options.case: Fuses cleanly (tear-off maps to share) and holds product clarity, but airline tickets are not the activists' world.
options.risk: Paper-craft perforations can slow scanning of a dense week.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels divided by hairline seams.
options.viewport: Persistent panels; navigation swaps panel contents.
options.case: Loses both axes: a tool costume, alien to street activists on phones.
options.kept: Persistent desktop panel that changes contents, not layout.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A course of numbered controls in purple over terrain.
options.case: Loses both axes: nobody in the movement reads orienteering maps; the line metaphor does the same job closer to home.
options.kept: A reserved colour for the active leg only.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.case: Loses both axes and breaks the red commitment.
options.kept: Tabular figure discipline for every time.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Coded colour strips instead of words.
options.case: Loses both axes: coded labels fight a two-tap share task.

options.label: Centre-rail Reference
options.thesis: Twin text columns round a keyed rail.
options.viewport: Two columns with a central key rail.
options.case: Loses both axes: a reading world for a sharing task.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean calendar app: agenda list and month grid, red as the accent.
canonCard.viewport: App bar, month strip, agenda cards with share buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any calendar app by design.
